description: This file defines interfaces and classes related to notification messages used in log view adapters for cluster log consistency in Orleans. It includes a base interface for notification messages, a version notification class, and a batched notification class.

classes.name: VersionNotificationMessage
classes.description: A notification message carrying only a version number.

classes.name: BatchedNotificationMessage
classes.description: A notification message containing a batch of individual notification messages with a maximum version indicator.

methods.name: BatchedNotificationMessage.Version
methods.description: Calculates the maximum version from the batch of messages.
